# Cutting Edge Design & Construction

High-end Florida remodeling, kitchens, bathrooms, interiors, landscape and outdoor living.

## Services
- [Kitchen remodeling](https://cuttingedgedesignfl.com/kitchen-remodeling): High-end kitchen remodeling brings layout, cabinetry, stone, lighting and everyday function into one coherent space. Cutting Edge Design & Construction helps Florida homeowners plan substantial kitchen transformations with a clear scope before construction begins.
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://cuttingedgedesignfl.com/bathroom-remodeling): Cutting Edge Design & Construction plans bathroom remodels that bring together tile, stone, vanities, lighting and comfortable daily use. The focus is a coordinated renovation, from the shower layout and preparation beneath the finishes to the final details.
- [Interiors & whole-home remodeling](https://cuttingedgedesignfl.com/luxury-interiors): A whole-home renovation should make the rooms work together. Cutting Edge Design & Construction focuses on high-end interior remodeling, combining living spaces, kitchens, bathrooms, flooring and architectural details into a cohesive plan for Florida homes.
- [Landscape & outdoor living](https://cuttingedgedesignfl.com/landscape-outdoor-living): Cutting Edge Design & Construction brings high-end landscape and outdoor living projects into the overall design of the home. Patios, courtyards, planting layouts, hardscape and outdoor kitchens can be planned as connected spaces for everyday use and entertaining.

## Service areas
Cocoa Beach, Ormond Beach, Daytona Beach, Flagler Beach, Palm Coast, New Smyrna Beach and Orlando. Larger projects in other Florida markets are considered by scope.
